culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Money Market Mutual Funds | 16,951,323 fair value
Total Fixed Income Mutual Funds | 179,450,525 fair value

findings.detail: E01 uses the full portfolio total without removing 196,401,848 of money-market and fixed-income mutual funds that are outside the extracted private-markets holdings scope.

rationale: The filing reports total investment portfolio fair value of 2,487,588,823. Its separately identified money-market mutual funds of 16,951,323 and fixed-income mutual funds of 179,450,525 sum to the entire 196,401,848 difference. Subtracting them yields 2,291,186,975, exactly the extracted holdings total. Thus the extracted private-markets universe reconciles, while E01 compares it to an unadjusted full-portfolio anchor.
